headline: Rather Than Paying 700 Million Won for Jeonse, 30-Somethings Take On 16 Trillion Won in Debt to Buy Seoul Homes [Truth Behind the Numbers]
summary: Average Seoul apartment jeonse deposits have exceeded 700 million won, and monthly rents reached 1.62 million won. More than half of first-time buyers were in their 30s, financing about 40% of purchases with loans.
why: Household mortgage debt and Seoul housing prices are key drivers of Korean banks' lending books and of domestic consumption.
